value.rationale: The minimum-volume enclosing ellipsoid is a natural affine-geometric invariant of a canonical enumeration polytope. A precise limiting axial ratio 3/5 (not isotropic), center scale and contact-stratum concentration provide an exact asymptotic geometric classification not mechanically given by face/volume counts. A future researcher using asymptotic convex geometry or extremal designs can use the exact constants.
residual_risks: Asymptotic classical model only; no finite-n closed coefficients or generalized b-polytopes.

final_claim: In standard Euclidean coordinates, classical parking-function polytope Löwner ellipsoid satisfies t_n/n→(sqrt5-1)/4, A_n/n^3→5(3-sqrt5)/24, B_n/n^3→(3-sqrt5)/8, B_n/A_n→3/5; every contact vertex layer accumulates only at k/n=0 or (3-sqrt5)/2.
limitations: Only leading-order n→infty constants; not finite-n all contact multiplicities.
